bible.logline: A high-octane, 9:16 vertical fashion collision through rainy midnight Soho, where two avant-garde models strut from London street grit into a gleaming SEPHORA flagship, culminating in a hero product lock.

environment.atmospheric_particles: Fine airborne London rain drizzle, water droplets on patent leather, cosmetic shimmer powder catching light.

Kaelen's charcoal blazer maintains chalk-white stripe accents without color bleeding.

camera_rig.composition: Dynamic vertical framing emphasizing towering model silhouettes, high-fashion angles, and macro beauty details.
camera_rig.route: Rapid tracking shots, snappy whip-pans, and stabilizing push-ins.
camera_rig.action_anchor: Model facial expressions and tactile product interactions.
camera_rig.focus_axis: Shallow f/1.8 depth of field creating vertical oval anamorphic bokeh in wet city lights.

foley_cues: Rapid rhythmic stiletto heel clicks on wet cobblestone
Passing double-decker bus wet tire spray and diesel roar
Pneumatic whoosh of glass sliding doors opening
Metallic magnetic click of luxury lipstick cap disengaging
Crisp paper bag snap and handle tension sound
sonic_blueprint.room_acoustics: Wet, reverberant London street exterior transitioning sharply into hyper-clean, acoustically dampened luxury retail interior.

master_bgm.genre_style: Syncopated UK Garage / Hyper-Pop Runway Sizzle
instrumentation: Syncopated 2-step drum groove with punchy kick and crisp rimshots
Glittering hyper-pop synth arpeggios and vocal chops
Dramatic snare roll risers and white-noise sweeps

stems.percussion: Rhythmic pulse and transient acoustic hits
stems.harmony: Mid-range chord progression and ambient pads
stems.lead: Hero melodic motif or lead arpeggio

master_bgm.dynamic_arc: Seconds 00-08: Snappy 2-step rhythm kicks in on the wink. Seconds 08-16: Heavy bassline drops inside flagship. Seconds 16-24: Massive riser sweep building energy. Seconds 24-32: Sudden cut to dead silence on final freeze-frame bag snap, leaving only a sub-bass decay.
master_bgm.lyria_prompt: High-energy UK Garage fashion runway track, 138 BPM, F Minor. Syncopated skipping 2-step beats, punchy kick drum, driving Moog bassline, glittering hyper-pop synth arpeggios, and edgy vocal chops. Builds rapidly with dramatic snare roll risers into an explosive, sleek high-fashion drop, ending abruptly on a crisp impact hit.

scenes.scene_title: The Soho Stare & The Night Pan
action_beats: Extreme vertical macro close-up on Model Maya's eye with shimmering holographic eyeshadow in Soho rain.
Maya executes a sharp, deliberate runway wink directly into lens at second 02.
On the wink, camera whip-pans 90 degrees right to reveal a rain-slicked Soho street with a motion-blurred red double-decker bus streaking past.
scenes.kinetic_contact_chain: Micro-eye movement -> High-velocity eyelid closure (wink) -> Triggered camera whip-pan acceleration -> Rapid rotational deceleration -> Wet asphalt perspective stabilization.
scenes.omni_prose_prompt: A 9:16 vertical high-fashion cinematic sequence begins in an extreme macro close-up on Model Maya's face matching <image_1>, focusing on her left eye adorned with shimmering emerald and gold holographic eyeshadow and immaculate winged eyeliner. Raindrops glisten on her cheek under wet Soho neon lighting at real-time 1.0x playback speed with zero slow motion. At second 02, Maya delivers a sharp, confident wink directly into the lens and whispers: 'London, wake up.' Triggered precisely by the eyelid closing, the vertical 50mm camera executes a high-speed horizontal whip-pan to the right, blurring neon lights into electric streaks before snapping to a halt in a medium-wide shot of a rain-slicked Soho cobblestone avenue, where an iconic red London double-decker bus streaks past in the background with wet asphalt tire hiss. Preserving continuous kinetic momentum and rotational inertia across the rapid whip-pan. Maintain crisp focal planes, rich saturated magenta and cyan reflections, and zero digital artifacting. Synchronized diegetic audio starts with the intimate, dry sound of an eyelid blink and whispered vocal close to mic, slamming instantly into a punching 138 BPM UK Garage drum hit, a whooshing whip-pan sound effect, and the wet tire spray of the passing bus.
conversational_edit_deltas: Turn 2: Enhance the neon reflections in the street puddles and add more visible rain mist.
Turn 3: Change the lipstick color on Maya to a deeper midnight burgundy while keeping the wink identical.

scenes.scene_title: The Bag Lock & The Soho Freeze
action_beats: The camera punches in 60 centimeters directly toward the SEPHORA shopping bag held firmly in Maya's hand.
The bag halts dead-center in the vertical frame, perfectly upright with sharp paper edges.
At second 30, the video cuts to a crisp editorial freeze-frame on the bag and SEPHORA logo, with blurred glowing Soho neon behind.
scenes.kinetic_contact_chain: Punch-in camera motion -> Arm locks bag at chest height -> Rope handles tension under gravity -> Abrupt momentum cessation -> Total frozen frame.
scenes.omni_prose_prompt: The vertical 9:16 camera executes a rapid, stabilized punch-in push of 60 centimeters directly toward the iconic black-and-white striped SEPHORA bag held firmly in Maya's gloved hand at chest height. Filmed at real-time 1.0x speed, the punch-in camera preserves kinetic momentum conservation before locking into the static freeze. The bag from <image_3> swings into the exact center of the vertical frame: its braided black rope handles are taut, its folded paper gussets are crisp and unwrinkled, and the embossed black SEPHORA typography is rendered in tack-sharp macro clarity. In the background, the glowing store portal and the wet London night street dissolve into beautiful out-of-focus bokeh circles. At exactly second 30, all motion abruptly halts into a pristine, high-resolution editorial freeze-frame on the bag, holding dead-still for the final two seconds with zero text distortion and zero geometric warping. Synchronized audio reaches its climax as the UK Garage track hits a massive final snare and bass drop, instantly cutting to absolute dead silence punctuated only by a single, crisp, mechanical SNAP sound effect as the frame freezes, with a faint, luxurious reverb tail decaying into the silence.
conversational_edit_deltas: Turn 2: Add a bold white sans-serif kinetic text overlay in the center that pops in reading 'FEEL THE PULSE'.
Turn 3: Shift the background bokeh color balance to rich ambers and golds.
